title: 2018 AMC 10A Problem 2
statement: Liliane has \(50\%\) more soda than Jacqueline, and Alice has \(25\%\) more soda than Jacqueline. What is the relationship between the amounts of soda that Liliane and Alice have?

answerChoices.label: A
answerChoices.text: Liliane has \(20\%\) more soda than Alice.

answerChoices.label: B
answerChoices.text: Liliane has \(25\%\) more soda than Alice.

answerChoices.label: C
answerChoices.text: Liliane has \(45\%\) more soda than Alice.

answerChoices.label: D
answerChoices.text: Liliane has \(75\%\) more soda than Alice.

answerChoices.label: E
answerChoices.text: Liliane has \(100\%\) more soda than Alice.

solutions.text:
Let \(x\) be the number of gallons of soda that Jacqueline has. Then Alice has \(1.25x\) gallons, and Liliane has \(1.5x\) gallons.

Therefore, the relationship can be found by dividing the amount of soda that each has to yield \(\dfrac{1.5x}{1.25x}=1.2,\) which means Liliane has \(20\%\) more soda than Alice.

Thus, A is the correct answer.
hints: Use Jacqueline’s amount as the base variable
Compare Liliane’s amount directly to Alice’s amount
